responsibility: Defines the `rustc_mir_transform` crate’s public orchestration of MIR transformation, lint, validation, and query entry points. It registers transform modules and pass names, wires provider queries, builds the analysis-to-runtime and optimization pass pipelines, and drives creation of optimized MIR, promoted MIR, and related pass sequencing for normal bodies, constructors, constants, and shims.
same_name_distinction: This is the main `rustc_mir_transform` crate root: it declares the MIR transform modules, installs query providers, and assembles the analysis and optimization pass pipelines. Unlike the other `lib.rs`, it is not a standalone proc-macro helper for tests under coverage; it is the production library entry point that drives compiler MIR processing.
